Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
PAPERS, PLEASE — GAMEPLAY NOTES (observed evidence unless marked guess)

CONTROLS / UI
- Documents arrive as booklets on the window sill (~0.15,0.72–0.79). Drag one onto the desk ("DRAG DOCUMENTS HERE") to open and read it.
- RETURN a document: drag it UP INTO the window opening (drop around y≈0.45). This is the verified method — dropping on the sill, the counter lip, the black hand-off bar, or the desk edge does NOT hand it back (many failed attempts).
- NEXT!/call control = black box on the pole near top-center (~0.30,0.22). Tooltip cycles "NEXT!", "ARSTOTZKA WELCOMES YOU", "HAVE YOUR DOCUMENTS READY", "ENTRY IS NOT GUARANTEED" — it is a slogan sign AND the advance control; pressing it after an inspection ends the entrant and opens the window for the next one.
- Gold lever/bell on the window frame (~0.30,0.34–0.375) toggles the window shutter/grille. It does NOT dispatch entrants.
- Stamp drawer: click/drag the thin tab at the far right edge (~0.99,0.44). Rail shows red DENIED (head ~x0.65–0.68, y0.37–0.44) and green APPROVED (head ~x0.87–0.89, y0.375), label "ALIGN VISA BENEATH STAMP".
- Stamping mechanic (worked out by trial): drag the passport so its dashed ENTRY VISA box's top edge sits just below the rail bar and is centered under the chosen stamp head, then click the knob (knob sits slightly LEFT of the text label). The impression prints at fixed screen position just below the rail at that head's x. VERIFY by dragging the doc down; mis-stamps land on the page's top edge outside the box and don't count.
- Rulebook: drag the book icon in the bottom toolbar (~0.215,0.85–0.90) onto the desk. Contents entries (Basic Rules / Regional Map / Booth Info) were clicked and eventually opened — coordinate accuracy matters. Map confirms Arstotzka is home; Impor, Republia, Kolechia, Antegria, Obristan, United Federation are foreign.
- Day-start bulletin: page-turning never worked (click corner, CHECK ALL PAGES button, drag, scroll all failed). Drag the paper off the desk to clear it.
- Pause menu: Escape. Options Fullscreen, HUDity (checkbox ~0.64,0.41–0.45), Music, Sound; RESUME ~0.50,0.75; MAIN MENU ~0.50,0.825; QUIT ~0.90; confirm dialog MAIN MENU ~0.50,0.44.
- NO mid-shift save: MAIN MENU → STORY → day select showed only "DAY 1 — NEW"; a stalled day can only be recovered by restarting that day.
- End-of-day: family screen (OK buttons), then ledger with SAVINGS/SALARY/RENT/HEAT/FOOD checkboxes (~x0.69; rent y≈0.575, heat ≈0.617, food ≈0.659) and SLEEP bottom-right (~0.92,0.90). Checking FOOD costs 20.
- Intro sequence after a restart: letter → lottery → map → apartment → title card → newspaper → WALK TO WORK; NEXT text position varied (~0.86–0.96), click the literal word.

RULES LEARNED
- Day 1 (Nov 23, 1982): stamp ENTRY VISA; admit Arstotzkan citizens only; deny all foreigners.
- Day 2 (Nov 24, 1982): foreigners with a VALID passport are admitted; deny entrants with inconsistent information or expired documents.
- Citations observed: (1) denying someone over sex/appearance mismatch = warning; (2) approving a non-matching photo = warning; (3) denying a passport whose small photo differed = −5 credits PENALTY. Lesson (evidence-based): the tiny photos are unreliable — do NOT deny on subtle facial differences; deny only on clear contradictions (expired date, contradictory data) or unmistakable mismatch.

OBSERVED ENTRANT OUTCOMES
- Day 1 first run: Zgajewski (ARSTOTZKA) approved and departed correctly.
- Restarted Day 1: Raeside, Ank (ARSTOTZKA, valid) approved, departed after passport returned through window. Tarnoff, Nadia (IMPOR) denied; Tuirvoska, Kamina (REPUBLIA) denied; Dupont, Valentina (KOLECHIA) denied — all correct under Day-1 rule; shift ended as entrant 5 arrived.
- Day 2: Winchova, Natanya (IMPOR, EXP 1984.03.18) approved. Arends, Micah (ANTEGRIA, EXP 1982.11.22, i.e. 2 days expired) denied. Roberts, Joseph (ANTEGRIA, valid) approved. Calevska, Hannah (ARSTOTZKA, passport SEX F, male-presenting entrant) denied → citation warning (WRONG). Hlovstad, Calle (REPUBLIA, valid) approved → citation warning for non-matching photo (WRONG). Grechiolo, Alyssa (ARSTOTZKA) denied for photo mismatch → −5 credits (WRONG). Fosing, Jovik (OBRISTAN, valid) — passport opened for inspection, night ended before stamping.
- One entrant handed an extra brochure ("The Pink Vice" ad card) along with a passport; it is not a required document and can be parked off to the side. Overlapping booklets on the sill can block grabs — move the pink M.O.A. citation aside first.

FAILED / UNRESOLVED
- Bulletin page turning, CHECK ALL PAGES, book page-turning via corners/bookmark: all unresponsive.
- Once the desk went dark and an entrant (hoodie man, next-in-line) never presented documents despite bell/shutter/bell-wait cycles, HUDity toggling, and drags — cause unknown (guess: softlock, possibly paperwork lost by my drags). Only a full day restart recovered it.
- Unclear whether feeding family / checking FOOD actually helps; food was left unchecked on Day 1. Family showed HUNGRY/SICK by end of Day 2.
- Guess (unverified): shutter must be open and documents returned before NEXT! reliably produces the next entrant.
